theme: Your last day on the water
greeting: Your last full day aboard, Dan — the calendar's empty and the Adriatic is yours. The one thing worth handling while you still have signal is tomorrow's move ashore to Cavtat.

needsAttention.title: Lock tomorrow's move ashore before signal drops
needsAttention.detail: You disembark at Komolac around midday Saturday and shift to the Cavtat hotel. Pre-book the transfer, confirm the hotel will hold bags before the 3 PM check-in, and arrange a pre-dawn Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight home. All of it needs doing from shore signal while you still have it.

flagged.title: Revolut card dispatched
flagged.detail: On its way, arriving Sept 23-25 — activate when it lands.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail sales, and statement notices — nothing waiting on you.
inbox.clear: No personal mail is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
